scope: Title, abstract and all pages containing the new Version 14 appendix; no clipping or overlap observed. The three previously overflowing displays now fit.
limitations: Unchanged earlier pages were not visually re-reviewed. This is layout review, not mathematical acceptance.
render_metadata_note: The old renderer's default edition field is v13 in rendered.json. Explicit current PDF path/hash and page selection were used, so that legacy default did not select a different PDF. R4 corrects the renderer's v14 support.
